title: n8 waveform scope build
description:
Owner spec PLAY-10, 2026-11-12 section 8.

The mid-gray reference is DERIVED, never hardcoded: 18% scene
linear pushed through the Rec.709 camera OETF power branch
(1.099 * L^0.45 - 0.099) lands mid-gray at ~40.9% coded signal
(8-bit bin 104) - NOT at 18% screen level, the spec's explicit
trap. WaveformScope.midGraySignal() is pure and JVM-tested
(mid_gray_reference_is_derived_not_linear asserts the value, the
not-18% property and the bin).

Honesty gate: the derivation is valid only while the analyzed
signal's luma path is the bare OETF, so the screen derives the
gate live from the grade (tonemap off, no LUT). The toggle
disappears the moment a tonemap curve or a LUT rewrites the
transform - no fabricated fixed line over a signal it does not
describe. The line draws dashed at the derived level under the
trace, in the theme's primary so it reads as a reference, not
grid furniture.
